turns.content: For three Ising spins S_i=+/-1/2 on a triangle, write H=-sum J_ij S_i S_j and introduce x_i=2S_i in {+1,-1}.
With J12=-1, J23=-1, and J31=+1, write the energy explicitly in terms of x1,x2,x3 and identify the common factor of one quarter.
Use global spin-flip symmetry to enumerate the distinct energies and give a sign assignment that attains the maximum.
State the maximum energy and convert the maximizing x_i assignment back to S_i values.
Explain how frustration prevents all three bonds from simultaneously taking their individually preferred values, and use that to check the maximum.
Give the final maximum, the attainable energy set, and one maximizing spin configuration.
